Qwen6-6bit-oMLX is the overall winner (0.840); Qwen4-4bit-oMLX nearly matches (0.773) — 4-bit holds up well.
Two-Mac GLM6 Tandem (0.738) does NOT beat the single-Mac oMLX configs; adds complexity without quality gain (finance weak 0.35).
Honesty is probe-dependent for every model; none passes all 3 traps. Calibration (acknowledging facts-insufficient + flagged guess) is the right behavior, present in Qwen6-oMLX date answer.
